```{r}
#| label: chapter-slides-cell-setup
#| include: false

# The slide builder appends this to its temporary knitr include only.
# Book cells keep their normal echo/output/include options.
knitr::opts_hooks$set(`slide-show` = function(options) {
  mode <- options[["slide-show"]]
  if (length(mode) != 1L || !mode %in% c("code", "output", "both")) {
    stop("slide-show must be 'code', 'output', or 'both' in chunk '", options$label, "'.")
  }
  options$classes <- unique(c(options$classes, "slide-visual", paste0("slide-show-", mode)))
  options$include <- TRUE
  options$echo <- mode != "output"
  options$results <- if (mode == "code") "hide" else "markup"
  options$fig.show <- if (mode == "code") "hide" else "asis"
  if (mode == "code") {
    options$message <- FALSE
    options$warning <- FALSE
  }
  # Do not change eval: display choices must not alter execution/dependencies.
  options
})
```
